newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates rise.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates for the Egyptian pound edged up in the private-sector market on Sunday to between 10-1/16 and 10-1/8 percent from Thursday's range of 9-3/4 to 9-7/8 percent, a private sector banker said.
But the banker said he had only heard it was at that level, and like three other bankers did not test the rate.
The bankers quoted one-week rates of around 10 and 10-1/4 percent, up from 9-7/8 on Thursday.
Public sector banks kept rates steady at 10-1/2 percent.
